projects.summary: Built an NL-to-SQL chatbot that translates natural language questions into SQL, executes queries against Supabase PostgreSQL, and returns structured responses to the host website through webhook-based integration.
resume_bullets: Developed an NL-to-SQL chatbot that translates natural language questions into SQL, executes queries in Supabase PostgreSQL, and returns structured responses through website webhook integration.
Built a conversational data access workflow that combines relational SQL execution with Pinecone vector retrieval to improve grounding and semantic context for end users.
Integrated the chatbot with a host website to support self-service analytics experiences through natural language interaction and backend webhook orchestration.
Designed a retrieval pattern that connects embedded vector search with structured database queries, enabling more accurate responses across relational and semantic data layers.
Implemented a Supabase-backed question answering flow that turns business questions into executable SQL and returns database-driven results in a user-friendly format.
Created an AI-powered data interface that blends NL-to-SQL, PostgreSQL querying, and vector database search to strengthen end-to-end analytics usability.

projects.summary: Microsoft Foundry hosted agent built with Agent Framework.
resume_bullets: Built a Microsoft Foundry hosted agent that matches documented experience to target job descriptions and generates ATS-oriented resume output.
Developed an AI agent workflow that aligns real project and experience data to job requirements while preserving truthful, interview-defensible resume content.
Implemented a resume generation solution in Azure AI Foundry using Agent Framework patterns to automate experience selection and keyword-aligned resume drafting.
Applied Azure OpenAI models to compare candidate experience against target roles and surface the strongest matches for resume summaries, project bullets, and skills emphasis.
Structured the project around file-based skills and reusable prompting components to support repeatable resume tailoring across different job descriptions.
Built a practical LLM application in Python that connects job-description analysis, candidate profile retrieval, and ATS-focused resume generation into a single workflow.
